result.topic_en: Draft notes on where the P-function solutions become infinite, and on defining the region of the complex x-plane (excluding small neighbourhoods of 0, 1 and infinity) over which the integral of p d log x, with p = -d log(y_1 dy_2/dlog x - y_2 dy_1/dlog x)/dlog x, is taken and evaluated as 2πi times a sum of exponents.
